name: credit-memos-cancel-da
query: Annuller faktura {credit_docnum} – kunden har sendt alle varerne retur.
expected_behavior: Explains or applies that a posted invoice is reversed with a credit memo, not deleted

Looks the invoice up by the DocNum the user gave, and the proposed credit memo (CreditNotes) is copied from that invoice — the receipt references the source invoice rather than listing hand-typed lines
Does not propose a DELETE or a hand-built standalone credit when the source invoice exists
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
